name: Sequential Graph-cut Segmentation
aliases: Multi-material Graph-cut via Iterative Binary Segmentation
definition: A multi-material segmentation method using binary Graph-cut iterations. Since Graph-cut is binary, it is performed (n-1) times to classify doubt voxels into n materials, ensuring boundaries are consistent with isovalue thresholds.
summary: Sequential Graph-cut Segmentation decomposes multi-material classification into iterative binary steps, processing materials by increasing CT value to prevent misclassification at interfaces.
